card.name: Converted inch or ounce values in parentheses
card.fires_on: The first digit of a converted imperial value (inches, oz) inside parentheses right after a metric measure like cm, mm or mL. It also fires on digits in inch sizes such as 3 1/2 inches.

modes.label: Inches after cm
modes.description: A digit opening the inch equivalent in brackets after a length in cm or mm.

modes.label: Other converted units
modes.description: A digit starting an equivalent in mg/mL or ounces after a metric amount.
modes.example: Argatroban Injection 50 mg/50 mL (<<1>> mg/mL) is ready for intravenous

card.plain: It marks the number in brackets that gives the same measurement in inches or ounces after a metric one.
